headings: Hive: Bio-Inspired Swarm Orchestrator for Claude Code
Step 2: Concurrency Profile (adaptive, learns from every run)
Default Configurations (data-driven from April 8 test suite)
Model Selection Rules (proven by timing data)
skills.description_zh: 为 Claude Code 编排并行子任务，按波次协调共享发现、并发规模和冲突处理，综合多路推理结果；原文采用仿生群体机制组织执行与复盘。

skills.name: hiverev
skills.description: Persona-driven review of anything, from any angle. Point it at a UI, a landing page, a cold email, a README, a pitch deck, an onboarding flow, an API design, or any artifact, pick who is looking at it and what lens they bring, and get a prioritized friction punch list. Lighter than /hivesim. Triggers when user says /hiverev, "review this as [persona]", "what would [persona] think", "find friction in this", or "critique this from the angle of [X]".
headings: Pipeline (lightweight, 5 phases, all in-context — no sub-agents)
Phase 3: Walk the artifact as the persona
Phase 4: Red team the review itself
skills.description_zh: 从指定人物和视角审查 UI、页面、邮件、README、演示、入驻流程或 API 等产物，形成按优先级排列的摩擦问题清单，比 hivesim 更轻量。

skills.name: hivesim
skills.description: Strategic wargame engine. 7-phase simulation pipeline that runs parallel market simulations, attacks its own conclusions, then imagines how the decision fails. Use for big strategic decisions, pricing changes, market entry, partnership evaluation, or any question where being wrong is expensive. Triggers when user says /hivesim or asks to wargame a decision.
skills.description_zh: 使用七阶段战略推演并行模拟市场、反驳自身结论并预想失败，用于重大决策、定价、市场进入和伙伴评估。

headings: Hive v4.0: Bio-Inspired Swarm Orchestrator for Claude Code
